bioconda.description: Lightweight Expression displaYer (plotter / viewer) of SummarizedExperiment object in R. This package provides a quick and easy Shiny-based GUI to empower a user to use a SummarizedExperiment object to view (gene) expression grouped from the sample metadata columns (in the `colData` slot). Feature expression can either be viewed with a box plot or a heatmap.
